title: #157 Environmental Influence
prompt: Nowadays, people believe that the environment influences their accomplishments. Some people think their success and accomplishment were influenced by the places where they grew up. Do you think the environment does or does not affect people’s accomplishment and how it affects? Please give an example of a famous person to support your statement.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the influence of environment on personal accomplishments, agreeing that environment plays a significant role.
keyArguments: The environment provides opportunities and resources that can either facilitate or hinder success.
Individuals with a disadvantaged background may face more challenges, while those with privilege have more access to resources that contribute to their success.
